questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The slope of a position-time graph of a moving body at any instant gives its:
questions.explanation: Slope is dx/dt, which is velocity. A straight line means uniform velocity and a curve means the body is accelerating.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 2: Motion in a Straight Line

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a cyclic thermodynamic process represented on a pressure-volume diagram, the net work done by the gas is:
options: Equal to the area enclosed by the closed curve
Equal to the change in internal energy
Equal to the heat absorbed minus the work done
questions.explanation: In a cycle the gas returns to its initial state so ΔU = 0, which means Q = W and all the net heat absorbed appears as the work given by the enclosed area.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A photodiode used to detect light is always operated in reverse bias because:
options: Forward bias would destroy the diode
The fractional change in reverse current with illumination is much larger and easier to measure
No current flows in forward bias
Light cannot reach the junction in forward bias
questions.explanation: In reverse bias the dark current is tiny, so the extra carriers generated by light stand out clearly, whereas in forward bias the large existing current would mask the change.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The molarity of a solution prepared by dissolving 4 g of NaOH (molar mass 40 g/mol) in enough water to make 500 mL of solution is:
questions.explanation: Moles = 4/40 = 0.1 mol, and molarity = moles per litre of solution = 0.1/0.5 = 0.2 M.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Potassium dichromate in acidic medium oxidises ferrous ions to ferric ions, while chromium is converted to:
questions.explanation: Each dichromate ion accepts six electrons, going from +6 to +3. The orange solution turning green is the visible sign used in volumetric titrations.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 4: The d- and f-Block Elements

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Ethanol has a much higher boiling point than dimethyl ether although both have the molecular formula C₂H₆O. The reason is that ethanol:
options: Forms intermolecular hydrogen bonds through its -OH group
questions.explanation: The ether oxygen has no hydrogen attached to it, so no hydrogen bonding is possible between ether molecules and much less energy is needed to separate them.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 7: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The ability of a mature, differentiated plant cell to regain the capacity to divide is called:
questions.explanation: Interfascicular cambium and cork cambium arise this way from fully mature parenchyma, and the same ability underlies plant tissue culture.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 13: Plant Growth and Development

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: An age pyramid of a human population that is broad at the base and narrows sharply towards the top indicates a population that is:
options: Expanding, with a high proportion of young individuals
questions.explanation: A wide base means many pre-reproductive individuals who will soon enter the reproductive age, so the population will keep growing. A stable population gives a bell shaped pyramid.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 11: Organisms and Populations

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: A frog can breathe through its moist skin even when it is completely submerged in water. This type of respiration is called:
questions.explanation: The skin is thin, moist and richly supplied with capillaries, so gases diffuse across it directly. On land the frog also uses its buccal cavity and lungs.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 7: Structural Organisation in Animals

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which of the following is a component of innate, non-specific immunity?
options: The skin as a physical barrier, along with mucus, saliva and phagocytes
questions.explanation: Innate immunity is present from birth and acts the same way against every pathogen through physical, physiological, cellular and cytokine barriers. The others are all acquired.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease
